# AHOS, Advanced Hybrid Online Systems

> AHOS is a digital product studio in Beirut, Lebanon. We design and build websites, online stores, mobile apps, custom software and AI automations for founders in Lebanon, the Gulf, Europe and the US.

Based in Beirut, Lebanon, since 2023. Working with clients in Lebanon, the Gulf, Europe and the US, in English, Arabic, French.
Every project gets a fixed quote in writing after a free 30-minute call. Clients own all code, designs and content. 30-day warranty on every build.

## Services and starting prices
- [Web development](https://ahos.xyz/web-development/): Fast, search-ready websites that turn visitors into enquiries. From $300, 1 to 4 weeks.
- [Online stores](https://ahos.xyz/ecommerce-development/): Shopify or custom stores with cash on delivery and WhatsApp ordering. From $500, 2 to 6 weeks.
- [Mobile apps](https://ahos.xyz/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android apps people keep on their home screen. From $1,000, 6 to 12 weeks.
- [Custom software](https://ahos.xyz/custom-software/): Dashboards, platforms and internal tools shaped around how you work. From $1,500, 6 to 16 weeks.
- [AI and automation](https://ahos.xyz/ai-development/): Assistants and WhatsApp flows that take repetitive work off your team. From $500, scoped on the call.
- [Interface and brand design](https://ahos.xyz/ui-ux-design/): Interfaces, identities and design systems that look like you meant it. From $200, 1 to 4 weeks.
- [Web3 and blockchain](https://ahos.xyz/web3/): Smart contracts, dapps and launches with a Web2-quality interface. From $2,500, scoped on the call.

## Selected work
- Threads Activewear (Online store, Beirut): Original Nike, adidas, On and The North Face, with cash on delivery anywhere in Lebanon in one tap. https://threadsactivewear.com
- SpeeAligner (Website and case portal, Lebanon): Clear aligner planning for dental clinics: treatment plans, case submission and a 24-hour turnaround. https://www.speealigner.com
- Jul's Auto Repair (Website, Raynham, Massachusetts): A local service site built around one action: call the shop or get directions in one tap. https://julsauto.com
- I Do Taxi (Website and iOS app, Beirut): Lebanon's 24/7 taxi service, bookable by app, phone or WhatsApp, with live dispatch behind it. https://www.idotaxi.net
